phases.name: High Noon
phases.say: (It burns white. There are no shadows left to stand in.)

say.open: (The heat arrives before the light does, and the light is laughing.)
say.death: (It sets, and for a moment everyone can see clearly.)

bestiary.lore: The card of joy and clarity, and a sun that is very glad to see you, and will not stop being glad.
bestiary.weakness: Water, heavily. Interrupt the flare while it charges.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn a four-row solar flare that burns; glare blinds a row between, and it warms itself back when hurt. At High Noon the flare comes every other turn.
